content: The paper introduces a novel methodology for joint feature selection and classification in healthcare data, focusing on longitudinal features and categorical responses. It uses an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm integrated with functional principal components to efficiently handle high-dimensional data and demonstrates its efficacy through simulations and an analysis involving chronic diseases.
